dedupe_keys.name: power tac electricity market simulation server

description: Power TAC is the project's competitive simulation server for studying retail electricity markets and distributed renewable generation. It contains Java simulation modules in a Maven project, with separate core modules and a sample broker implementation. Users supply broker agents and simulation settings; the server supports experiments on their market interactions. Geographic coverage and time horizon belong to the configured experiment, not a fixed real-world system. Apache-2.0 source is free on GitHub, with a developer wiki and generated API documentation. A limitation is that the server repository depends on the separate powertac-core project, and competition outcomes are not observations of an operating market. The platform supports agent-based studies of electricity-market design and distributed-resource coordination. PyPSA (model-pypsa) provides a related optimisation-based perspective. The main project website was unavailable through the web reader, but the own repository and deployment guidance remained accessible.
